tables.name: rental_agreements
tables.description: Histori sewa/penempatan dengan snapshot harga, tanpa menyalin owner/property yang dapat diturunkan dari kamar.

constraints.name: agreement_closed_on_required
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'active'::text) AND (closed_on IS NULL)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['checked_out'::text, 'transferred'::text])) AND (closed_on IS NOT NULL) AND ((closed_on >= start_date) AND (closed_on <= (end_date + 1))))))

constraints.name: rental_agreements_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'active'::text) AND (closed_on IS NULL)) OR ((status <> 'active'::text) AND ((closed_on >= start_date) AND (closed_on <= (end_date + 1))))))

constraints.name: rental_agreements_room_id_daterange_excl
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (room_id WITH =, daterange(start_date, COALESCE(closed_on, (end_date + 1)), '[)'::text) WITH &&)

constraints.name: rental_agreements_room_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (room_id) REFERENCES rooms(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: rental_agreements_tenant_id_daterange_excl
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (tenant_id WITH =, daterange(start_date, COALESCE(closed_on, (end_date + 1)), '[)'::text) WITH &&)

constraints.name: rental_agreements_tenant_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: transactions_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'rent'::text) AND (invoice_id IS NOT NULL) AND (property_id IS NULL) AND (admin_fee = 2000)) OR ((kind = 'boost'::text) AND (invoice_id IS NULL) AND (property_id IS NOT NULL) AND (admin_fee = 0) AND (amount = 30000))))

constraints.name: transactions_invoice_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id) REFERENCES invoices(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: transactions_property_id_fkey

policies.qual: ((owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR private.is_admin())

policies.with_check: ((accepted_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND private.can_read_complaint(complaint_id))

((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public_listings() l(id, name, location, address, description, base_rent, gender_policy, room_size, total_rooms, available_rooms, images, facilities, rules, landmarks, promoted)
  WHERE (l.id = favorites.property_id))))

policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM messages m
  WHERE ((m.id = message_attachments.message_id) AND (private.is_member(m.conversation_id) OR private.is_admin()))))
((id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR private.related_tenant(id) OR private.is_admin())

policies.with_check: ((owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND private.has_role('owner'::text))

policies.qual: ((id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR private.related_tenant(id) OR private.is_admin())

(((kind = 'rent'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM invoices i
  WHERE ((i.id = transactions.invoice_id) AND private.can_read_agreement(i.agreement_id))))) OR ((kind = 'boost'::text) AND private.owns_property(property_id)) OR private.is_admin())
((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR private.is_admin())
